beats.say: The BBC reports Kylie Jenner made her Victoria's Secret catwalk debut.
According to the BBC, she wore the Fantasy Bra created with Jacob and Co.
The BBC notes the catwalk show was scrapped after 2018 amid criticism.
The BBC adds the show returned in 2024 to celebrate all women.
Now, the BBC reports Jenner has stepped out in the headline piece.
What did you make of her runway debut?
